answer: Each identity stakes a mineral parcel on the state survey. Each epoch the seed names a parcel and demands a sealed forty-gram sample: a courier scans the tamper bag and an accredited lab reports isotope ratios against the reference core. One seam cannot back two accounts, dealer stone fails the fingerprint, and one operator's parcels fold to a vote. Fees, assay and freight run near $530 a year, so a thousand clones cost $530,000 and need a thousand separate seams. Banded onyx carries the signature of its seam, juniper roots anywhere on the slope above, and one oyster yields one pearl.
